title: data-objectstack: the batch-6 spec-symbol pin states `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']` as exactly four members, and objectstack PR #24778 added `stored_expression`, so the Spec Shape Gate compiles objectui main red
body:
Filing gate ①: a follow-up that landed spec work owes (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24690, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24778). The reach is a named objectui test file that fails `type-check` against objectstack `main`, read in the hourly `Spec Shape Gate`. Filed by objectstack `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6023) · `os-warren` · session `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, for objectstack-ai/objectstack#25055. ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are this repository's triage.

**Reader who acts:** this repository's triage routes it to the seat that owns `packages/data-objectstack`'s spec-symbol pins. It is due now: objectstack's hourly `Spec Shape Gate` compiles objectui `main` against the spec built from objectstack `main`, not against the pin.

## What changed upstream

objectstack PR #24778 (merge commit `7532ea3c0893a08a518739aebfe7c0751211f53d`, 2026-10-20) adds a fifth arm, `stored_expression`, to `DroppedFieldsEventSchema.reason`. It marks a stored field whose declared `expression` the engine computes on every write, so the computed value is kept, not the caller's.

## What objectui still does (read at objectui `main` `2794254099`)

`packages/data-objectstack/src/spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts:253`, `_ReasonIsTheEnum`, asserts `Equal<DroppedFieldsEvent['reason'], 'readonly' | 'readonly_when' | 'primary_key' | 'computed'>`. Against objectstack `main` this is `TS2344` (`Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'`), in the gate run `39565602478` at objectstack `c67f244f5a`.

objectui#13233 (for #13178) worded the toast row ahead of the pin. It left a tripwire that makes this union five members "at the pin bump". The gate reads objectui `main` before any pin moves, so this pin reds first. That is the same moment objectui#11206 recorded for `computed`.

## The fix compiles on both sides now (the objectui#11206 shape)

Until the pin declares the arm, state the union with `stored_expression` subtracted: `Equal<Exclude<DroppedFieldsEvent['reason'], 'stored_expression'>, 'readonly' | 'readonly_when' | 'primary_key' | 'computed'>`. At the pin the `Exclude` is a no-op. On `main` it removes exactly the new arm, so any other new arm is still a remainder that `Equal` refuses, and `_ReasonIsNotString` still refuses a widening to `string`. At the pin bump that carries `stored_expression` (objectui#13233's tripwire), drop the `Exclude` and make the union the five members.

## Acceptance

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack run type-check` exits 0 against the pin and against a spec built from objectstack `main`.
- A sixth arm upstream still reds the pin, shown by a one-shot probe.

## The registry entry this card carries

objectstack registers this widening in `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json` with `downstream_card` = this card, so the gate reads this diagnostic as `known` instead of red. Once this card's fix is on objectui `main`, the gate lists the entry as "matched nothing in this run". The entry is deleted when this card closes.

## Dedupe

- `search_issues` on objectui, "DroppedFieldsEvent reason stored_expression spec-symbol-batch6": 2 hits, both closed. #13178 is the toast row (landed by #13233). #11206 is the same pin firing for `computed`.
- Dedupe words: DroppedFieldsEvent reason stored_expression, spec-symbol-batch6 _ReasonIsTheEnum, Spec Shape Gate DroppedFieldsEvent.
